scope: 本地隔离持续任务运行、当前可观测异常、管理员确认及loopback通知夹具；实施合同不等于验收收据或生产调度证明。
prerequisite: Stage26已闭环并授权实施；Stage27首轮未验收，修复后重新锁定完整执行输入，完成所有18套实际双端验收再冻结。

ownership.root: stdlib Python独立runner、已有commerce中文后台、构建与证据。 唯一fresh前置seed工具backend/local_task_bootstrap.py（QA真实调用）；两backend不得各自实现浏览器bootstrap。
ownership.python: backend运行身份/config/tick/native wrappers/collector/告警及通知持久化。
ownership.cloud: 对应D1/Worker native wrappers/collector及真实native R2消费者复用。
ownership.qa: 新fresh SQLite、明确独立wrangler state/port、实际HTTP通知夹具、强停重启、并发及权限撤回。

configValidation.revision: 0..9007199254740991 integer; PATCH full object CAS; no bool
configValidation.ruleVersion: trimmed string length1..80 when enabled; empty permitted while disabled
configValidation.intervalSeconds: Integer5..3600 for callbacks/recovery/objects/notifications; monitor30..3600. No bool.
configValidation.thresholdSeconds: Each exact key independently null or integer0..31536000. null means no aging rule authorized, not infinite/zero. ruleVersion length1..80 nonblank when enabling.
configValidation.enableGate: environment gate ready AND immutable local-isolated runtimeId AND confirmed=true AND nonempty ruleVersion. config.enabled=false stops new claims.

environmentGate.EW_LOCAL_TASK_RUNTIME_ID: explicit UUID lowercase36, persisted exact id on first explicitly fresh local bootstrap; restart must match
environmentGate.EW_LOCAL_TASK_MANIFEST_SHA256: 64 lowercasehex; must equal persisted marker.manifest_hash. Env alone never inserts/repairs a marker.

runtime.identity: Marker maximum1, immutable insert-after-first/update/delete rejected. Enabled env+runtimeId+manifestSHA must match the pre-seeded marker. Normal GET/PATCH/tick never insert or repair identity.
manifestRules: Only explicit --manifest and --base; no default database/state/port, no original preview/production DB, no default wrangler state.
GET runtime id/backend/appSha256 and actual GET /experience bytes must all match manifest before a tick. APP SHA is APP identity only, not a claim of all source/build identity.
Manifest, CLI logs, DB and API never contain session/password/env secret raw values. Secret-bearing server env references are resolved only in server/runner process; no legacy plaintext fallback.

statePath is the explicit launcher declaration, not proof that an HTTP server inspected the host filesystem path. runtimeUUID establishes DB/state continuity; native fixture/state ownership is separately verified by the launcher.

First launch uses sole bootstrap helper above before health; restart uses --verify-existing only. Verify actual GET /experience SHA against both explicit --app and manifest.core.appSha256 after app starts.
runtime.authentication: Runner uses an explicitly supplied current real admin session by server-side/runner env reference. Every tick/native wrapper rechecks current sessions/role/account closure and final actor fence. Never fabricate handler.user/a.user or expand trustedService/service_allowed. No automatic password login or session renewal after revocation. First authorized tick binds workerId permanently to runtimeId+actor+session_hash; same workerId with another session is409, never silently replace session_hash. Explicit new authorized session requires an explicit new workerId; no registration/update API.
runtime.loop: Single stdlib process, one outstanding tick per worker; graceful stop sends no new tick. Lost transport is unknown until server lookup/reconciliation, not cancelled. Reconnect probes must match runtime identity; changed id/app stops writes.
runtime.sessionLoss: Runner displays auth_required and stops writes; old DB run may remain running/unknown. Only a new actually authorized admin may reconcile it. No trusted-service fallback writes a success marker after actor loss.

bootstrapProtocol.owner: root sole backend/local_task_bootstrap.py; no public/admin HTTP bootstrap route
firstCli: --state <explicit absolute SQLite file or fresh wrangler persist path>
bootstrapProtocol.firstPreconditions: Refuse existing state target and existing manifest. Resolve target within user-authorized workspace/fresh scope; reject default/remote/shared/production paths. No implicit defaults or shell-built commands.
bootstrapProtocol.canonicalHash: SHA256 UTF8 JSON of manifest core only, recursively sorted keys/no spaces/ensure_ascii=false, no self hash field. Store manifestSha256 beside core in file and marker.manifest_hash. No session/credential fields.
bootstrapProtocol.sqlite: Use exclusive file creation (fail if exists); seed only ops_runtime_identity marker in the new SQLite database, transactionally. Actual product init later creates normal tables and never inserts/replaces a marker.
bootstrapProtocol.cloud: Resolve bundled native Node/Wrangler; exec each argument structurally, with explicit --local --persist-to <new --state> --config <explicit config> and target D1 binding. Seed marker before first health/API request. Never remote or default Wrangler state. Preserve own fresh resources on failure for diagnosis; no retry into another existing state.
bootstrapProtocol.marker: ops_runtime_identity(id=1,runtime_id=manifest.core.runtimeId,mode=local-isolated,created=manifest.core.created,manifest_hash=manifest.manifestSha256), immutable and at most one row.
bootstrapProtocol.restartCli: Same flags plus --verify-existing: require existing exact manifest/state, recompute canonical SHA and actual --app bytes, read/verify same marker. Never seed/reset/upsert or create a replacement state/identity during restart.
bootstrapProtocol.product: init_schema only CREATE tables/triggers; never auto INSERT runtime marker from env or browser payload. Unmarked DB gives runtime.mode=unconfigured; PATCH/tick cannot confer isolated identity. Validate all three env runtimeEnabled/runtimeId/manifestSHA against marker before any claim.
bootstrapProtocol.truthBoundary: statePath is a launcher declaration verified by local CLI file/state operations, not something Cloud HTTP claims to have physically inspected. DB UUID+manifest hash prove marker continuity, not production resource isolation.

runnerProtocol.startup: Verify manifest canonical SHA, server runtime identity/env marker and actual GET /experience bytes before any tick. No implicit state, port, workerId, credentials or login. First tick registers only the supplied workerId with the actual current session; existing matching tuple is a restart, not a session rebind.
runnerProtocol.lostResponse: Keep one outstanding immutable tick requestId in runner memory. On transport loss reuse that requestId with identical runtimeId/workerId/appSha256, or GET runs filtered by workerId+requestId. Never infer failure/success from HTTP abort.
runnerProtocol.restart: After SIGKILL, same explicit session and workerId may inspect prior persistent runs before new work. New session requires new explicit workerId; old worker remains bound and its read projection is auth_required when its original session is no longer current/valid. No automatic relogin or silent credential refresh.
runnerProtocol.staleRun: Only a new actual authorized admin tick may mark an expired run unknown/lease_lost after schedule expiry under current runtime/config guards. It never impersonates the prior actor or changes native business status to success.

nativeExecution.payment_callbacks: Explicit server-only wrapper around current PaymentCallbacks.process; current real admin require+original rate key preserved; use canonical inbox only.
nativeExecution.payment_recovery: Extract/reuse current admin batch loop as server-only process_batch; retain current owner/order/query binding and receipt-only consumer; no body/user spoofing.
nativeExecution.privacy_objects: Reuse current admin process_objects/processObjects and authorized existing owner-confirmed/real closure queue guards. Python SQLite has no R2 and reports applicable=false; Cloud uses real native BUCKET delete+HEAD.
nativeExecution.payment_monitor: Read-only capture original financial snapshot plus actual current callback/recovery/late/object sources; does not auto-fix ledger/stock/entitlement/refund.
nativeExecution.alert_notifications: Only local fixture outbox consumer below; no arbitrary URL/recipient supplied by API/runner.
limits: Each wrapper keeps its own current admin require/rate. No limiters disabled; cadence defaults respect original30/min write/financial reads.
Original business leases30s/max5 and nextAttempt remain unchanged. Runtime schedules60s are separate and never clear business attempts or force manual_review back to retry.
Late settlement runs only through verified existing receipt logic; refund_pending/refund_processing is not an automatic refund or auto-ack.
No automatic creation/confirmation of private-data cleanup jobs or expiry scopes. Only the already-authorized object queue is in this task whitelist.
Adapter disabled/not ready is a skipped runtime step, not repeated business claims consuming the five attempts.
nativeExecution.claimFence: All automated callbacks/recovery/object native wrappers pass the server-only optional hook specified in schedule.claimFence. Ordinary existing routes do not pass it and retain exact previous behavior. Monitor collection/outbox writes use their own whole guarded transaction, notifications use per-unit guarded claims; none accepts proofs or business results from the runner.

schedule.claim: Atomic due+lease-expiry+configRevision+enabled CAS and actual admin fence; run inserted with claim in same transaction/batch. Claim one due kind per tick, ordered next_due/kind. Keep separate persisted run/schedule tokens; every automated native unit also uses claimFence below in its native mutation transaction.
schedule.network: outside DB transaction; recovery worst case5x8s≈40s. Privacy R2 IO currently has no firm outer timeout: defaultlow batch, budget observation, unknown/lease_lost on transport/lease uncertainty; abort is not cancellation.
schedule.disable: Runtime disable/unready/insufficient budget blocks every new native unit through current per-unit hook plus final SQL ops_claim_fences guard, not just an entrance check. An already claimed operation remains subject to its original business gates; do not misreport it cancelled. Runtime metadata final stores still need valid run/schedule/config/actor guards, otherwise unknown/lease_lost.
schedule.finish: Same run/schedule lease token and configRevision CAS; stale old worker cannot overwrite newer completion. Actual native result recorded server-side, never accepted from runner as authoritative processed/payment status. Run and schedule each persist lease_token/lease_until; finish binds both tokens and the claimed configRevision. Never overwrite a newer schedule nextDue or config.
schedule.retry: Business and notification max5 preserved. Runtime network loss reuses the same tick requestId; no new requestId resets existing work. Recovery of expired runtime lease marks prior run unknown/lease_lost by a new real admin and relies on original business CAS.
schedule.stepBudget: Before every notification/new native business claim recheck runtime identity, both run/schedule leases, current configRevision/enabled and actual admin. Default batch1. Stop initiating further IO when the remaining60s schedule budget cannot cover the configured operation deadline plus finalization margin; do not extend a lease or imply that timed-out/aborted IO was cancelled. An already in-flight uncertain step is unknown/lease_lost, never a fabricated zero-failure completion.

claimFence.purpose: Every automated native unit claim is authorized by the same database transaction/batch as its actual native mutation, not only a tick entry check. This is a server-only optional hook; normal existing public/admin business routes do not pass it.
claimFence.table: ops_claim_fences; exact8 ordered fields in tables; no HTTP create/list/update endpoint, no client supplied proof.
claimFence.tokens: run_lease_token and schedule_lease_token are explicit independent fields. Both must exactly match the separately persisted current run and schedule lease tokens; never assume they are equal or collapse them into one proof.
claimFence.pythonSignature: ClaimFence = Callable[[GuardedConnection], None]. Optional keyword claim_guard=None on automated process/claim call chain; call guard(db) immediately after that unit BEGIN IMMEDIATE and before attempt++ or any preclaim terminal/recover mutation. Hook inserts one current proof in that same db transaction.
claimFence.cloudSignature: type ClaimFence = () => Promise<D1PreparedStatement[]>; optional fence argument on automated process/run call chain. Hook returns the current real a.stmt proof prefix only. claimBatch(ops,fence) computes prefix=fence?await fence():[], awaits a.db.batch([...prefix,...ops]) and returns results.slice(prefix.length). Preserve old native result indexes after slicing.
claimFence.freshness: At each hook call re-read runtime env/manifest gate and actual caller, retain captured-deadline fast checks, and verify config/task/actor/dual-token predicates in the final native transaction. The eighth proof field is freshly computed by SQL at execution as DB_NOW + this operation requiredBudgetMs; both actual persisted lease_until values must exceed it. Never substitute captured deadlines or an application timestamp for the final remaining-budget guard.
beforeInsertGuard: Current immutable ops_runtime_identity row id=1 has mode local-isolated, runtime_id equals run.runtime_id and worker.runtime_id; hook also verified current env runtimeId/manifestSHA against this row.
NEW.run_id identifies status running; run.actor=NEW.actor, run.config_revision=NEW.config_revision, run.lease_token=NEW.run_lease_token, run.lease_until>DB_NOW and >NEW.stamp.

The schedule kind equals run.kind, schedule.last_run_id=run.id, schedule.config_revision=NEW.config_revision, schedule.lease_token=NEW.schedule_lease_token, schedule.lease_until>DB_NOW and >NEW.stamp.

Current ops_task_config revision equals NEW.config_revision and its exact parsed data enabled=true, confirmed=true, nonempty ruleVersion, tasks[run.kind].enabled=true. Do not rely on stale copied TaskConfig JSON from the tick entrance.

run.worker_id identifies the original worker; worker.actor=NEW.actor, worker.session_hash=NEW.session_hash and runtime_id matches the immutable runtime. The real current session with this hash belongs to NEW.actor, is not revoked and expires>DB_NOW. The same actor still has actual admin role and has not closed their account.
The request retains the original account_write_guard fence; no fake user/service identity or widened service_allowed. Proof stamp is server-generated, never accepted from API/runner.
claimFence.triggers: BEFORE INSERT checks all predicates and RAISE(ABORT,ops_claim_rejected) on failure. AFTER INSERT immediately deletes this proof row; insert/native mutation/delete share the same native transaction/batch. This transient table is never an authorization cache or durable lease replacement.

callbackPositions.python: PaymentCallbacks.process(actor,data,claim_guard=None) passes hook to claim(actor,claim_guard=None). After claim BEGIN, guard runs before candidate mutation, including attempts>=5 manual_review/recover branch; no hook on apply/failed postclaim transactions.
callbackPositions.cloud: process(limit,actor,fence?) uses claimBatch for both attempts>=5 recover batch and normal claim+alias+attempt+SELECT batch. sliced native claimed[3] remains the original SELECT result.

recoveryPositions.python: Admin process_batch/data loop passes claim_guard through execute/run to claim(job_id,actor,claim_guard=None). After claim BEGIN it guards normal attempts++, local terminal preclaim completion and attempts>=5 manual_review. Public own recovery route passes no hook; receipt consumption after an existing job claim passes no runtime hook.
recoveryPositions.cloud: process(data,actor,fence?) passes to run(id,actor,fence?). Guard terminal preclaim batch, attempts>=5 UPDATE converted into a batch, and normal claim+attempt+SELECT batch. sliced native claimed[2] remains original SELECT result.

privacyObjectPositions.python: Automated Python native wrapper reports applicable=false because this runtime has no R2 queue IO. If shared process_objects receives a hook, call it before each actual eligible unit mutation inside its BEGIN transaction, never on reads or after claimed unit completion.
privacyObjectPositions.cloud: processObjects(limit,admin,fence?) wraps its one unit claim UPDATE in claimBatch([stmtUPDATE],fence)[0], including attempts>=5/identity manual-review transition. Existing actual object delete/head/final verify uses its original30s business lease and current authenticated account/queue guards.

claimFence.failureBoundary: Claim hook/prefix failures occur before the native business try/catch and before attempt increment; propagate a fixed runtime claim/lease/auth failure to the outer tick, never translate into storage_unavailable, native retry or a burned attempt. Failed transaction changes no native row/audit. If runtime lease/config/actor is already lost the old tick cannot fabricate run success; retain uncertain old run for actual-authorized stale reconciliation.
claimFence.alreadyClaimedBoundary: Do not insert a new ops fence into an already-claimed unit postIO persistPaid, receipt-only consumer/apply, native finish/failure or R2 verify completion. Those finish under their original30s business lease, owner/config-specific gates and actual authenticated account fence. Runtime disable stops new claims and does not retroactively cancel already-started operations.
claimFence.stampSemantics: The unchanged internal stamp column is a transient required-until threshold, not an event timestamp: SQL DB_NOW + requiredBudgetMs at the actual INSERT. Callback new claim needs1000ms; recovery/notification new claim needs9000ms. Existing Python metadata/monitor default0 and Cloud finalization/monitor margin1000ms remain; already-claimed original business completion boundaries are unchanged. No HTTP client may supply it; AFTER self-delete leaves no durable proof.

apis.body: full TaskConfig including revision CAS; exact keys

apis.response: {item:Alert,actions:AlertAction[],actionsNext,notifications:Notification[],notificationsNext,attempts:NotificationAttempt[],attemptsNext,receipts:NotificationReceipt[],receiptsNext,productionEnabled:false,externalSent:false}; each50 DESC: actions/notifications/attempts by(created,id), receipts by(confirmed_at,id), cursor belongs same alert/category or400; no internal secrets.

body.note: trimmed1..1000 Unicode chars, no controls except tab/newline

apis.response: {item:Notification,productionEnabled:false,externalSent:false}; only retry/manual_review and attempts<5, never reset attempts

validationAndAccess.IDs: [A-Za-z0-9:_-]{1,100}; decode exactly one path segment, reject malformed encoding/slashes; requestId min8
validationAndAccess.adminOnly: All listed routes require current real admin. Anonymous401, wrong role403, unknown id404, malformed400, CAS/idempotency/runtime mismatch409, disabled/unready tick503. GET runtime/config remain readable while disabled.
validationAndAccess.tickIdempotency: unique(actor,requestId) and canonical fingerprint(runtimeId,workerId,appSha256). Same body returns original run/current persistent result; different body409. Even idle/skipped ticks persist one idempotent run. A client may not send kind/source ids/processed results/owner/token/URL.
validationAndAccess.workerBinding: workerId permanently binds runtimeId+actual actor+first session_hash. Another runtime/actor/session reuse is409; a new explicit authorized session must use a new workerId. All worker heartbeats are actual authorized DB mutations; GET may project stale/auth_required from current original session facts without impersonated writes or silently rebinding it.

MonitorCoverage.unsupportedMetrics: nullable real channel metrics, never fake0

knownSources: canonical payment_callback_inbox joined transaction primary receipt
digitalFiniteGrants: immutable finite digital checkout snapshots and original applied payment linked to finite grants
membershipMaterializedQuota: already materialized periods and their original paid snapshot/grant events
membershipBoundJobs: already existing membership-period gateway jobs, allocations and reserve/settle event links
rules: callback_backlog:received/retry/expired processing older than configured callbackBacklog
callback_manual_review:canonical receipt manual_review, code and receipt/order localization
recovery_backlog/persistent query error:existing job actual status/attempt/error, configured age where applicable
late_refund_pending/late_refund_processing:durable work-item ageing, not proof that money refund failed
privacy_object_pending/manual_review:actual deletion job id and code; no object URL/key in alert
recon:<code>:covered actual error finding e.g. paid-item entitlement missing and original financial mismatch
digital_grant_missing/digital_grant_binding_mismatch: only verified historical finite checkout+unique applied sandbox_pay facts; independent of old generic commerce entitlement existence.
membership_period_binding_mismatch/membership_grant_event_missing/membership_grant_event_orphan: validate already materialized historical quota facts, never demand lazy unmaterialized buckets.

membership_job_allocation_missing/membership_job_binding_mismatch/membership_job_settlement_mismatch: validate existing membership_period jobs/allocations and their actual accounting links, including orphan allocations.
monitor.coverage: Store scan id/time/source availability/truncated/loaded limits. Missing or truncated sources are not-covered, not zero. Original reconciliation LIMIT5000 and old uncovered declarations remain truthful; new collectors separately label newly covered local callback source. A null threshold, disabled category/task, missing source or changed policy is not-covered, never proof condition cleared. Keep prior open/acknowledged alerts unresolved under those conditions.
monitor.episode: unique(ruleCode,sourceType,sourceId,episode). Stable repeated scans update lastSeen/seenScanCount only, never inflate failure counts. Store minimal lastSourceVersion from trusted status/attempt/code metadata, not body/hash of personal content. Alert.summary freezes thresholdSeconds/ruleVersion/configRevision/source observed time for interpretation; source updates are only trusted typed metadata, no private body hashes.
monitor.stateMachine: open -> acknowledged -> resolved. Ack is requestId+version CAS and immutable actual-actor note, not business resolution or source mutation. Only a later complete covered scan proving the condition cleared may resolve; partial/unknown/source-not-found does not auto-resolve. A genuinely reappearing condition after verified resolution starts a new episode.
monitor.writeAtomicity: After capture, scan/alert creation+version update/episode allocation/outbox insertion/resolve are one guarded DB transaction or D1 batch bound to current runtimeId + run.id/status=running + exact run and schedule lease token/expiry + claimed configRevision=current confirmed enabled config + actual current admin fence. Finish-run CAS alone is insufficient. Old/expired scan writes no alert/outbox/resolve/nextDue updates. Resolve also CASes alert version/lastSourceVersion and never overwrites newer observed state.

digitalFiniteGrants.expectedFacts: Only an already existing valid finite digital_order_snapshots row joined to its original sandbox order/item and exactly one original commerce_payment_events(kind=sandbox_pay,status=applied,environment=sandbox) with matching owner/order creates an expectation for one finite grant. Existing generic commerce_entitlements does not satisfy the finite grant expectation. Do not pick min/max payment time from multiple ambiguous ledger facts.
bindingChecks: grant.id='digital:'+item.id, unique grant.item_id and owner/order/item/content/media/policy_snapshot match the immutable checkout snapshot plus original order/item; original_quantity=item.quantity and uses_per_unit=frozen policy usesPerUnit.
Frozen policy JSON is valid/typed with integer validityDays1..3650 and usesPerUnit1..1000, not bool/string; no current settings are used to recalculate original terms.
starts=the unique original applied payment.created, not checkout snapshot.created/grant.created/updated/current time; expires=starts+frozen validityDays*86400000 and expires>starts.
digitalFiniteGrants.historyBoundary: A later refund/full refund, expiry, policy disable, asset disable or course withdrawal does not excuse a missing historical finite grant once original immutable finite snapshot and trusted original applied payment exist. Do not require current order.payment_status=paid or current access BASE_GUARD to recognize this history.
legitimateNoGrant: legacy order without a finite checkout snapshot; never retroactively create a snapshot/grant or report it as missing finite grant
unpaid finite checkout without original applied payment
late refund_pending without a normal applied sandbox_pay ledger; retained payment/refund work-item facts remain separate
digitalFiniteGrants.lateFulfilled: Late fulfilled follows the same original applied payment/finite snapshot grant rules as ordinary payment.
digitalFiniteGrants.notCovered: Missing required table, truncated input, malformed/ill-typed policy JSON or ambiguous original payment identity marks this source affected coverage not-covered with a fixed reason. No fabricated zero-issue result and no resolution of existing alerts from uncovered facts.

membershipMaterializedQuota.expectedFacts: Inspect existing periods and existing grant events only. A paid membership snapshot with no bucket, no grant event and no membership-source job is a legitimate lazy-unmaterialized state; never create a missing-bucket finding just because a payment exists.
bindingChecks: period.id='mai:'+sha256(canonical JSON [owner,item_id,cycle_start]); unique(owner,item_id,cycle_start); referenced item/snapshot/subscription/original payment rows exist with matching owner/order/item/subscription and sandbox environment.

snapshot.payment_event_id identifies original sandbox_pay/applied event matching snapshot order/owner; frozen benefits.aiCredits is strict int0..1000000 and equals period.credits, including legitimate0; period.benefits_snapshot equals the original snapshot benefits by canonical parsed JSON.

cycle_start/cycle_end match month/year/billing_period calculation anchored at this snapshot original period_start with original UTC month-end/leap-day clamp; do not anchor to current subscription period/current_item_id. Cycle lies within that original paid window, and creation must not grant a future unpaid/unstarted window.

Every existing period has exactly one event id='grant:'+period.id with action=grant, matching owner/period_id, job_id='', credits=original period.credits and grant-created anchor. An existing grant event referring to a missing period is also a missing binding finding.
lazyAndHistoryBoundary: No automatic requirement to materialize future renewal periods, past missed cycles or periods whose benefits are null/resetCycle none. Zero credits is valid, not a missing positive grant.
pause/grace/past_due/trial/current policy disabled or revision changed does not itself demand a new bucket; cancellation of renewal keeps its paid current period.

Later snapshot revocation, subscription expired/revoked/current_item_id pointing to future renewal, order refund, entitlement revoked, account closure or bucket closing/closed does not erase original historical paid snapshot/bucket/grant facts. Validate original immutable linkage, not current LIVE/access predicates.
membershipMaterializedQuota.notCovered: Required table missing, truncated inputs, malformed/ill-typed frozen policy/benefits/snapshot JSON or ambiguous original paid identity is not-covered with a fixed reason; no fake zero or alert resolution.

membershipBoundJobs.expectedFacts: Inspect only already existing jobs with quota_source=membership_period plus existing allocations (including orphan allocation with no job). No job or allocation is invented from a subscription payment or a grantPending view.
bindingChecks: Each actual membership-source job has exactly one allocation by job_id. job.owner/quota_period_id/reserve_credits match allocation.owner/period_id/reserved_credits and referenced period.owner; original reserve_credits>0 and bound period.credits>0. A legitimate0-credit bucket does not authorize a positive reserved job.

queued/running job requires allocation.state=reserved and charged_credits NULL; terminal succeeded/failed/partial/cancelled requires allocation.state=settled, allocation.charged_credits=job.charged_credits and strict integer0..reserved_credits.

Reserve event id='reserve:'+job.id must have action=reserve, same owner/period/job and original reserve credits. Terminal jobs additionally require id='settle:'+job.id with action=settle and charged credits. Match original ai_gateway_quota_events reserve/settle job/owner/credits links, without comparing today's policy revision.

Existing allocation without job, wrong quota_source, missing period, cross-owner or mismatched source/period/reserve/terminal charge is a binding finding. Do not demand current bucket active/positive available balance for historical or already-inflight settlement facts.
release:<job> and close:<period> expire_unused events are conditional actual positive unused recovery facts; do not require them for0 remainder/no-recovery cases.
membershipBoundJobs.notCovered: Required table missing, input truncated or malformed/ill-typed required data is not-covered; never treat unavailable accounting evidence as0 issues or resolve prior alerts.

captureRules: These3 coverage keys are independent of legacy reconciliation. Preserve original reconciliation findings/LIMIT5000/uncovered truth; do not rewrite old receipts or let generic entitlement existence conceal finite grants.

Read only consistent relational tuples (joined query/transactional source capture); avoid mixing pre-settlement job with post-settlement allocation from separate asynchronous reads and manufacturing a mismatch.
No lifecycle.sync, quota refresh, grant=True, entitlement repair, wallet transfer, refund, order or allocation mutation occurs during monitor capture.

Store source availability/loadedRows/totalRows/truncated/covered plus fixed uncovered reasons. Partial/missing/malformed/ambiguous input never means healthy0; only complete covered later evidence may resolve the corresponding source alert.
Coverage is historical materialized link validation, not automatic on-time quota grant, full quota balance conservation, provider billing audit or re-evaluation of legacy test_wallet applicability.

notifications.mode: loopback-fixture only; default unconfigured, not a real provider adapter

environmentGate.EW_LOCAL_ALERT_FIXTURE_ENDPOINT: Validate original ASCII string first against ^http://(?:127\.0\.0\.1|\[::1\]):([1-9][0-9]{0,4})/task-alert-fixture/events$ and port<=65535. Then parse. Reject localhost,127.1,integer/hex IPv4,mappedIPv6,userinfo/query/fragment/other path/host; preserve original string in binding.
environmentGate.EW_LOCAL_ALERT_FIXTURE_SECRET_REF: ^EW_LOCAL_ALERT_[A-Z0-9_]{1,80}$; server env resolved value32..500chars; no raw values in DB/log/API

notifications.outboxCreation: In the guarded complete covered monitor transaction/batch, create at most one immutable outbox per active(open|acknowledged) alert episode when explicit fixture gate is ready. If unavailable, leave delivery unavailable locally; a later ready complete covered monitor may create its one missing outbox. Do not backfill resolved episodes or claim prior external delivery. UNIQUE(alert_id,episode) and event_id preserve identity.
notifications.bodyRules: Strict exact keys, canonical UTF8 JSON, no owner identity/name/body/admin note/credentials/session/URL/object key; <=8192 bytes.
notifications.request: Actual POST, timeout8s. Cloud fetch redirect:manual, Python no-redirect opener; reject every redirect. X-EW-Alert-Timestamp epoch seconds and X-EW-Alert-Signature HMACSHA256 hex over timestamp+dot+raw canonical bytes. Explicit fixture protocol only.
notifications.acknowledgment: Accept exact HTTP200 and parsed media type application/json (optional charset=utf-8, case-insensitive) only. Read actual bytes with hard8192 limit regardless of Content-Length; fatal UTF8 decoding, duplicate-key rejection, no constants, strict exact object {accepted:true,eventId:same exact string}; accepted must be boolean true. Response timestamp integer seconds +/-300 and signature64hex HMAC over raw bytes required. Every redirect/204/202/othercode/wrongcharset/malformed/mismatched/unsigned ACK is unconfirmed.
notifications.durability: After verified matching ACK, persist own NotificationReceipt row and notification.status=fixture_confirmed in the same guarded DB transaction. Confirmation means only actual local fixture acknowledgment, externalSent remains false.
notifications.retry: Attempts increment only on lease claim. Retrying the same event keeps eventId. Explicit retry only retry/manual_review and attempts<5; no counter reset or replacement notification to evade max5.
notifications.adapterBinding: Capture current ready binding at each new lease claim (only enabled/endpoint/ref/secretHash SHA256, no secret). Store it on notification and attempt. Re-read env/config proof after IO and final CAS; config disabled/rotated old ACK cannot confirm.
